info.name: Amazon EBS Amazon Elastic Block Store (EBS) API
info.description:
Amazon EBS provides persistent block storage volumes for use with Amazon EC2 instances, offering consistent and low-latency performance for workloads that require persistent storage.

Contact Support:
 Name: Kin Lane
 Email: kin@apievangelist.com
